<!-- All news items below this line -->

;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian Civil War]]:
**The [[Syrian Army]] and their Lebanese ally [[Hezbollah]] begin an assault to retake the strategic border town [[Syria|Yabrud]] from the [[Syrian rebels]]. [http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/syria-fighting-age-men-leave-homs-22458242 (AP via ABC)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/2014/02/12/us-syria-crisis-talks-idUSBREA1B0TX20140212 (Reuters)]
**[[Russia]] says it will veto a U.N. resolution on humanitarian aid access in Syria, claiming that the draft is an effort to prepare for military strikes against [[Bashar al-Assad|President Bashar al-Assad]]'s regime. [https://www.reuters.com/article/2014/02/12/us-syria-crisis-russia-aid-idUSBREA1B0HN20140212 (Reuters)] 

*[[War in North-West Pakistan|Militants in northwestern Pakistan]] kill nine male family members of a slain leader of a pro-government militia in an attack on the family's house outside the city of [[Peshawar]]. [http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/militants-kill-anti-taliban-militia-pakistan-22473810 (AP via ABC)] [http://www.cnn.com/2014/02/12/world/asia/pakistan-violence/index.html?hpt=wo_c2 (CNN)]

;Disasters and accidents
*The UK's [[Met Office]] issues a "red warning" and warns of an [[UK storms of January-February 2014|exceptional storm]] as winds of up to 100mph are forecast to hit [[west Wales]] and [[north west England]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-26153889 (BBC News)]
*As the [[Early 2014 North American cold wave|North American cold wave]] continues, a [[February 2014 winter storm|massive winter storm]] across states in the [[southern United States]] causes widespread power outages, travel disruptions and dangerous road conditions. [http://www.nbcnews.com/storyline/deep-freeze/bone-chilling-catastrophic-winter-blast-wipes-out-power-south-n28156 (NBC)] 
*A [[sinkhole]] opens underneath the [[National Corvette Museum]] in [[Bowling Green, Kentucky|Bowling Green]], [[Kentucky]], swallowing eight vintage [[Chevrolet Corvette|Corvettes]] including the millionth Corvette built. [http://www.autoblog.com/2014/02/12/national-corvette-museum-sinkhole/ (Autoblog)]

;Health and environment
*A [[measles]] outbreak from the [[Philippines]] has spread into [[Australia]], [[Canada]], [[Taiwan]], and the [[United Kingdom]]. [https://www.thestar.com/life/health_wellness/2014/02/10/measles_outbreak_in_philippines_slowly_spreading_to_canada.html (''The Toronto Star'')] [http://www.philstar.com/headlines/2014/02/12/1289532/measles-philippines-spreading-canada (''The Philippine Star'')]

;International relations
*[[French President]] [[François Hollande]] is hosted by [[US President]] [[Barack Obama]] at a [[White House State Dinner#United States|White House state dinner]], during a visit by Hollande to the US aimed at [[France-United States relations|renewing the partnership]] between the two countries. [http://www.cnn.com/2014/02/11/politics/state-dinner/index.html?hpt=po_c1 (CNN)] 
*[[Garbage]] from Canada is discovered being dumped in the Philippines. [http://au.ibtimes.com/articles/538347/20140212/canada-garbage-dumpsite.htm#.UvsRA_ldWa8 (''International Business Times'')]

;Law and crime
*The Philippines recovers [[United States dollar|US $]]29 million from [[Ferdinand Marcos|Ferdinand Marcos']] bank accounts in [[Switzerland]] and [[Singapore]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/asia_pacific/philippines-recovers-29m-from-marcos-accounts/2014/02/12/085fe740-93a7-11e3-9e13-770265cf4962_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]

;Politics
*The BBC is told that the UK's three main political parties, the [[Conservative Party (UK)|Conservatives]], [[Labour Party (UK)|Labour]] and the [[Liberal Democrats (UK)|Liberal Democrats]], will declare that whoever forms the government after the [[United Kingdom general election, 2015|next general election]] will not agree to a currency union with an [[Scottish independence|independent]] [[Scotland]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-scotland-scotland-politics-26163637 (BBC News)]
*Protesters march against the government in various cities across [[Venezuela]] with at least two people killed in the demonstrations. [https://www.reuters.com/article/2014/02/12/us-venezuela-protests-idUSBREA1B1K220140212 (Reuters)]

;Sports
*[[New York Yankees]] shortstop and captain [[Derek Jeter]] announces he will retire following the [[2014 Major League Baseball season]]. [http://espn.go.com/new-york/mlb/story/_/id/10444978/derek-jeter-says-2014-last-season-via-facebook-post (ESPN)]
